cover_letter:
Dear Furt'Her team,

I'm thrilled to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position. Your mission to connect founders, talent, and innovation ecosystems resonates deeply with me. I'm a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content, and I love turning complex ideas into compelling stories.

At Episto, I've been responsible for on-page SEO, writing keyword-targeted blog content, and building and maintaining client websites in WordPress. I've also managed social media integration for these sites, ensuring a cohesive online presence. On my own project, mirook.com, I've designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and social media integration to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has taught me how to capture and communicate activities, partnerships, and impact effectively.

I'm particularly drawn to Furt'Her because of your focus on AI, emerging technologies, and entrepreneurship. I'm curious about these fields and eager to learn more. I'm also comfortable working independently in a small, international environment, and I'm proactive in bringing my own ideas to the table.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can easily commute to Brussels for hybrid work. I'm available to start as soon as possible and can commit to a minimum of 3 months. I'm excited about the opportunity to take ownership, experiment, and help give visibility to your growing ecosystem.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Furt'Her's story.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

## Profile
